name: Fluid Lite USD Vault
oneLiner: fLiteUSD is Fluid's USDC strategy vault; deposits route to Fluid fUSDC and multi-strategy deployments, with a 0.05% exit fee and administered NAV accrual.
collateral: USDC deposited into Fluid's UUPS-upgradeable FluidLiteVault; deposits auto-route into Fluid Lending fUSDC while StrategyHandler (0x066e84ca...) pulls funds into Ethereum and cross-chain yield strategies including FluidMainnetStrategyProxy (0xf3c971c6...) and SolanaStrategyL1
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 NAV shares over USDC with an auto-accruing exchange price governed by the maximum of a configurable fixed rate (6.00% APR as of 2026-11-27) and an annual reward distribution ($3M per year), reconciled upward by StrategyHandler up to 200 bps per call; instant withdrawals draw from the vault's fUSDC buffer subject to a 0.05% withdrawal fee (configurable up to 0.50%, retained in the vault) and revert when fUSDC buffer liquidity is insufficient or withdrawals are paused

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: Pharos Listing Policy v2 Batch 2 review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The operational ERC-4626 claim is the UUPS-upgradeable Ethereum FluidLiteVault proxy (0x273da948aca9261043fbdb2a857bc255ecc29012 -> implementation 0xe16ccc91a8134d428e7b6240177f9e2b227b9743), not direct ownership of Circle fiat reserves. At finalized Ethereum block 26506658 (2026-11-27T12:51:35Z), verified implementation source routes deposited USDC immediately into Fluid fUSDC (0x9fb7b4477576fe5b32be4c1843afb1e55f251b33) and lets StrategyHandler (0x066e84ca92529b500592867d0be89e78563fa965) pull USDC into Ethereum and cross-chain yield strategies while pricing shares from an administered exchange-price accumulator. Creation transaction 0xe1fde0e2171ce5d6b02d6070ace63d6f581fc0a5ba5ff3b2695c70d4d75ecf61 deployed the proxy at block 24616005 on 2026-03-08T23:22:59Z.

sources.label: Ethereum PublicNode RPC: pinned reads at finalized block 26506658 (2026-11-27T12:51:35Z)

pooledClaim.basis: At finalized Ethereum block 26506658 (2026-11-27T12:51:35Z), raw USDC held directly by FluidLiteVault is zero because deposits route into Fluid fUSDC (11,546,560.40 USDC, 28.17% of 40,983,976.38 USDC vault totalAssets). StrategyHandler.getIdleAssets() (11,597,101.64 USDC) equals that 28.17% fUSDC buffer plus 50,541.24 USDC at StrategyHandler (0x066e84ca92529b500592867d0be89e78563fa965), while four registered strategy proxies reported 41.93M gross (FluidMainnetStrategyProxy 0xf3c971c6... 13.45M, FluidSolanaStrategyL1Proxy 28.47M, dust on Arbitrum and Plasma) against the 29.44M (71.83%) net residual (a 12.54M / 30.60% gross-vs-net gap while StrategyHandler.getNetAssets() reverted). Because sub-strategies and Solana custody are opaque at live runtime, live reserve telemetry publishes a pooled claim without asserting 100% USDC look-through.
